faq.title: Got Questions? We Have Answers.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about PDFMinty's private, in-browser PDF tools.

items.q: How does PdfMinty process my PDF files privately?
items.a: PdfMinty executes our standard PDF tools (merging, splitting, compressing, protecting, editing, signing) 100% locally inside your web browser using WebAssembly and client-side JavaScript without uploading files to any server. The only exceptions are our opt-in AI Analyze and OCR PDF tools, which transmit extracted text or page images to Google Gemini only after you explicitly check a consent box.

items.q: Is PdfMinty completely free to use?
items.a: Yes — Guests receive 5 free daily tasks with no account or credit card required, Free registered users receive 10 daily tasks, and exported files never carry watermarks.

items.q: Do my files ever leave my computer or mobile device?
items.a: For our standard PDF tools, no — processing happens entirely in your local browser memory and works offline once loaded. The only exceptions are the opt-in AI Analyze and OCR PDF tools, which send extracted text or page images to Google Gemini only after you explicitly check a consent box.

items.q: What file formats and PDF versions are supported?
items.a: PdfMinty supports standard PDF documents across all versions, including password-protected PDFs, scanned document pages, and standard image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP) for PDF conversion.

items.q: How does PdfMinty compare to online converters like iLovePDF or Smallpdf?
items.a: Traditional PDF converters upload your confidential documents to external cloud servers to process them. PdfMinty processes standard tools locally on your own CPU and memory, eliminating upload wait times and keeping sensitive files on your device.

grayscalePdf.guideLead: Converting high-resolution color PDF documents to pure monochrome (grayscale) is one of the most effective strategies for slashing file byte size, optimizing documents for bulk office printing, and preparing legal or academic filings according to strict publication guidelines.
grayscalePdf.adv1Text: Strips redundant 24-bit RGB and 32-bit CMYK color channels, compressing documents by up to 60-80%.
grayscalePdf.adv2Text: Eliminates color cartridge bleeding and prevents accidental color print billing.
grayscalePdf.adv3Text: Meets official submission criteria for courts, patent registries, and academic libraries that enforce monochrome requirements.

grayscalePdf.algoText2: during page re-rasterization. This ensures that yellow highlights, subtle charts, and colored contrast text remain perfectly legible without muddying into solid black or washing out into white.

sanitizePdf.actionsDesc: This process permanently neutralizes embedded JavaScript, OpenAction triggers, and potentially harmful Launch actions hidden inside the PDF structure.
sanitizePdf.guideTitle: Understanding PDF Document Sanitization & Threat Neutralization
sanitizePdf.guideDesc: PDF documents are much more than static visual pages; they are structured, interactive binary containers capable of embedding executable JavaScript scripts, remote network triggers, automated form actions, and rich XML Metadata (XMP) packages. Sanitization is the process of inspecting and systematically purging hidden data layers and active elements to make documents safe for public release.
sanitizePdf.liJs: Embedded JavaScript & Triggers: Removes executable scripts attached to button clicks or page load triggers (/OpenAction, /JS).
sanitizePdf.liMeta: Hidden Metadata & XMP Packages: Strips camera GPS tags, revision histories, and author fingerprints.
sanitizePdf.liLaunch: External Launch Actions: Neutralizes commands that attempt to execute external software or open unverified URLs (/Launch).
sanitizePdf.liForm: Form Scripting & Stored Data: Clears unrendered calculation scripts and background tracking fields.
sanitizePdf.liLegal: Legal & Compliance Teams: Disclose filings and evidence without exposing draft revisions or privileged metadata.
sanitizePdf.liGov: Government & Whistleblowers: Protect the anonymity of reporters, researchers, and public servants.
sanitizePdf.liSec: Cybersecurity Officers: Disarm potentially weaponized PDF attachments before opening or distributing them to team members.
sanitizePdf.step1: Select File: Drag and drop your target document into the uploader above.
sanitizePdf.step2: Automatic Engine Analysis: Our WebAssembly engine scans the internal object dictionary for JavaScript, OpenAction hooks, and XMP streams.
sanitizePdf.step3: Download Clean Document: Download the sanitized, fully sterilized PDF with complete confidence.
sanitizePdf.offlineNotice: PdfMinty operates 100% inside your browser environment. Your confidential files are never transmitted across the network or stored in external databases, guaranteeing total data security and GDPR/HIPAA alignment.

adobeAlternative.faq1A: No. Open the tool in your browser and use it. Nothing to download, nothing to register, and no background software daemons running on your machine.

adobeAlternative.faq3Q: Can PDFMinty fully replace Adobe Acrobat?
adobeAlternative.faq3A: For merging, splitting, compressing, rotating, watermarking, password protection, metadata sanitization, and image/PDF conversion — yes, for virtually all everyday office tasks. If you strictly require commercial prepress CMYK color separations, legacy XFA dynamic forms, or hardware PKI smartcards, retain Acrobat.
adobeAlternative.faq4Q: Is a browser-based tool as safe as a desktop app?
adobeAlternative.faq4A: Since your file never leaves your device, there's no upload step and no server storing a copy of your document — see our related post on PDF tool security for the full picture, including the limits of that claim.
adobeAlternative.faq5Q: Does PDFMinty work when offline or on an airplane?
adobeAlternative.faq5A: Yes! PDFMinty is built as a Progressive Web App (PWA). Once loaded in your browser, its WebAssembly engine and scripts are cached by the browser Service Worker, allowing full offline execution without Wi-Fi.
adobeAlternative.faq6Q: Are electronic signatures made on PDFMinty legally valid?
adobeAlternative.faq6A: Yes. Under the US ESIGN Act and EU eIDAS regulations for Simple Electronic Signatures (SES), signatures drawn and flattened directly into documents carry full legal enforceability for standard agreements and NDAs.
adobeAlternative.faq7Q: How does client-side compression achieve up to 80% file size reduction?
adobeAlternative.faq7A: By converting heavy color profiles to grayscale, resampling raster images to high-density screen resolutions, and applying lossless Flate stream compression entirely in local browser memory.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.updated: Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • Last Updated & Reviewed: October 18, 2026 • Controller: PDFMinty Security & Compliance Architecture Team
privacyPolicy.summary: PDFMinty's 20+ standard PDF tools process your files 100% locally inside your web browser using client-side JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, and Web Workers without uploading your documents to any server. Your sensitive files never leave your device. If you explicitly opt in to use our Cloud AI tools — the AI PDF Assistant (/ai-analyze-pdf/) or the OCR PDF tool (/ocr-pdf/) — extracted text or selected page images are transmitted securely via TLS-encrypted HTTPS proxy to the Google Gemini API solely to fulfill your immediate request after you grant explicit consent. If you optionally sign in with Google OAuth or Email/Password, we store only your basic account profile (email, name, avatar URL, UID, and subscription/quota status) in Google Cloud Firestore in strict compliance with the Google API Services User Data Policy (Limited Use requirements).
privacyPolicy.sec1Desc: When you select a PDF or image file in any of PDFMinty’s standard utilities (including Merge PDF, Split PDF, Compress PDF, Protect PDF, Unlock PDF, Rotate PDF, Sign PDF, Watermark PDF, Add Page Numbers, Delete Pages, Extract Pages, Reorder Pages, Flatten PDF, Grayscale PDF, Repair PDF, Edit PDF Metadata, Sanitize PDF, PDF to Image, Image to PDF, Compare PDF, and PDF to Markdown), the entire operation executes locally on your device using client-side WebAssembly (@cantoo/pdf-lib, pdfjs-dist), HTML5 Canvas (fabric, signature_pad), and dedicated Web Workers.
privacyPolicy.sec2Title: 2. Zero Document Storage, No File Uploads & Memory Purging
privacyPolicy.sec2Desc: We do not operate backend file servers, cloud storage buckets (such as AWS S3 or Google Cloud Storage), or document databases that store, cache, or log your PDF files. All binary file transformations happen strictly within your device’s volatile Random Access Memory (RAM).
privacyPolicy.sec3Title: 3. Opt-In Cloud AI Features Disclosure (AI Analyze PDF & OCR PDF)
privacyPolicy.sec3Desc: PDFMinty provides two clearly labeled, optional AI-powered tools: the AI PDF Assistant (/ai-analyze-pdf/) and OCR PDF (/ocr-pdf/). Unlike our standard local tools, these two features require cloud inference via the Google Gemini API, strictly after you grant explicit user consent. PDFMinty never retains or stores your documents on our servers, and all processing is ephemeral for your immediate query.
privacyPolicy.secGoogleTitle: 4. Google User Data, OAuth 2.0 Authentication & Account Information
privacyPolicy.secGoogleDesc: All 22 PDF tools on PDFMinty are publicly accessible to guest users without requiring registration or login. However, if you optionally choose to create an account or sign in using Google Sign-In (OAuth 2.0) or Email/Password authentication (powered by Google Firebase Authentication), we request basic profile information from your Google Account: your email address (userinfo.email), display name and profile avatar URL (userinfo.profile), and unique Google user identifier (openid / UID). We use this information solely to authenticate your identity, establish your secure session, track your daily processing task quotas, and manage your membership tier (Free vs PRO) in Google Cloud Firestore. PDFMinty never requests or accesses your Google Drive files, Gmail messages, Google Contacts, or any external Google Workspace data.
privacyPolicy.secLimitedUseTitle: 5. Google API Services User Data Policy (Mandatory Limited Use Disclosure)
privacyPolicy.secLimitedUseDesc: PDFMinty's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacyPolicy.secRetentionTitle: 6. Data Retention, Account Deletion & Access Revocation
privacyPolicy.secRetentionDesc: We retain your user account profile (email, display name, UID, and subscription status) in Google Cloud Firestore only for as long as you maintain an active account with PDFMinty. You have the absolute right to revoke access via Google Security Settings (https://myaccount.google.com/permissions) and request permanent deletion of your personal data at any time via your Account Dashboard or by emailing support@pdfminty.com. Upon request, your account record is irreversibly purged within 7 business days.
privacyPolicy.sec4Intro: PDFMinty uses Google AdSense to display advertisements on public informational pages to support free access to our browser PDF toolkit. To comply with Google Publisher and AdSense policies, please review the following required advertising disclosures:
privacyPolicy.sec4Li1: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies (such as the DoubleClick DART cookie) to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this website or other websites on the Internet.
privacyPolicy.sec4Li2: Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to our users based on their visits to PDFMinty and/or other sites on the Internet.
privacyPolicy.sec4OptOut: Users may opt out of personalized advertising at any time by visiting Google's

privacyPolicy.secCmpTitle: 9. Consent Management Platform (CMP) & Cookie Preferences (EEA, UK & Switzerland)
privacyPolicy.secCmpIntro: For visitors located in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and worldwide, PDFMinty enforces strict opt-in cookie controls powered by Google Consent Mode v2.
privacyPolicy.sec5Title: 10. Web Analytics, Error Telemetry & Abuse Prevention
privacyPolicy.sec5Desc: PDFMinty uses privacy-respecting website performance analytics (Google Analytics 4 with IP anonymization enabled and Cloudflare Web Analytics) to measure aggregate traffic trends, page load speeds, and core web vitals. We never log document filenames, PDF text contents, or personal identities in analytics events.
privacyPolicy.sec6Title: 12. International Privacy Rights (GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA & Global Laws)
privacyPolicy.sec6Intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you hold statutory rights under data protection regulations including the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the UK GDPR, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), and Brazil’s LGPD:
privacyPolicy.sec6Li1: You have the right to request a copy of any personal account data held by PDFMinty, request correction of inaccurate data, or demand complete erasure. Because standard PDF tools run 100% locally in your browser, we never possess your PDF files.
privacyPolicy.sec6Li2: PDFMinty does not sell, rent, or monetize your personal information, Google user data, or document contents to any third parties.
privacyPolicy.sec6Li3: You may configure your web browser to reject cookies or clear local storage at any time without impacting the core functionality of our client-side PDF tools.
privacyPolicy.sec7Title: 14. AI Bots, Crawlers & Search Engine Verification Access Policy
privacyPolicy.sec7Desc: PDFMinty supports open web standards. Search engine crawlers (Googlebot, Bingbot), Google OAuth and Brand Verification crawlers, Google AdSense crawlers (Mediapartners-Google and Google-Display-Ads-Bot), and benign AI indexers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) are explicitly permitted to access, crawl, and verify our homepage, privacy policy, terms of service, and all 30+ public PDF tools without authentication.
